pages.text: $(bold)Maximum Cursed Energy$() = Cursed Energy Reserve level × (Cursed Output level + Cursed Affinity/10) × 500$(br2)For example: Reserve 3, Output 2, Affinity 10 → 3 × (2+1) × 500 = 4500.$(br2)$(bold)Regeneration$(): while wearing a core, restore (Cursed Output level + Cursed Affinity/10) × 5 points every 5 seconds.$(br2)Creative mode is treated as having infinite Cursed Energy, so casting costs nothing.
